title: The Reactivity Series and Displacement
summary: Ranking metals from most to least reactive, and using displacement reactions to prove it.

ib.note: Links to extraction of metals and redox (MYP 4–5)

cbse.chapter: Ch 3: Metals and Non-metals (reactivity series, displacement reactions)
Curiosity Ch 4 / Ch 5 (iron nail in copper sulfate)

objectives: I can recall the order of common metals in the reactivity series.
I can predict whether a displacement reaction will happen.
I can use displacement results as evidence to rank metals.
I can write word equations for displacement reactions.
misconceptions: Any metal can displace any other metal.
In displacement, the metal 'dissolves and disappears' (it turns into a salt).
The colour change is caused by the metal rusting.
